name: Seinaiji (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Seinaiji village emblem in green: a disc crossed by a white diagonal stroke with a small bar at the hoist.
history: Flag of the former village of Seinaiji in Nagano Prefecture, dissolved on 2009-03-31.

features.role: Seinaiji village emblem — a disc crossed by a white diagonal stroke with a small bar at the hoist
